comments.body:
I believe the way the study program is set up currently, LinAlg I is only examined in the summer together with LinAlg II (so likely between Aug. ~5 and ~25). I'm pnly about 90% sure because I'm studying physics and there is a slight difference in first year courses (although it is almost identical, you share most of the lectures.

Check the [study guide](https://ethz.ch/content/dam/ethz/main/education/bachelor/mathematik-angewandte-mathematik/files/math_bsc_guide_2021_de.pdf) to make sure that's the case.

Analysis I is in the winter block so likely between the 20th of Jan. and 10th of February.

Saying anything more precise than that is impossible this far in advance.

The academic calendar lists the dates of the exam sessions, they are 100% in that time window.

[Academic calendar](https://ethz.ch/students/en/news/academic-calendar.html)
